verdict.rationale: Teams is a SaaS collaboration product with built-in Copilot AI features, so a training-data opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair question to ask. The only AI-related item says Copilot can be used 'securely' with work data (ms-teams-docs-15/31), but it says nothing about whether customer data is used for model training or how to opt out. No evidence in the pack addresses this capability.
